extraction: LangChain.js Memory Overview: Memory system remembers previous interactions for personalization, learning from feedback, adapting to preferences. Types: Semantic memory (facts, concepts, relationships - like school learning), Episodic memory (past events/actions - experiences), Procedural memory (rules/skills - how to perform tasks). CoALA paper: facts to semantic, experiences to episodic. AI agents use semantic memory to personalize by remembering facts from past interactions. Episodic memory recalls past events/actions. Memory crucial for agents to remember, learn, adapt.
